speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (a) whether the running of hawker centres by social enterprises on a not-for-profit basis has achieved its desired outcomes; (b) whether it has reduced the overall operating costs for hawkers and food prices for consumers; and (c) whether it has helped attract new hawkers to the trade.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Hawker centres are places where Singaporeans from all walks of life can interact while enjoying hygienic and affordable food.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: To meet the changing needs of society while ensuring the sustainability of the hawker trade and the affordability of hawker food, the Government has been exploring alternative management models where socially-conscious operators are appointed to manage hawker centres on a not-for-profit basis.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: These operators have the flexibility to innovate and customise solutions for each centre.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The feedback from both hawkers and patrons of these centres has been largely positive.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The operators monitor the prices of basic food items at these hawker centres to prevent unreasonable price hikes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: In addition, some operators have ensured that the hawkers offer at least a few affordable entry-level meals in their menu.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The operators also organise events at these hawker centres to further enhance the vibrancy of the centres.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: To help hawkers address any manpower constraints they may face and manage manpower costs, the operators have implemented some innovative productivity measures.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: For example, the operator at Ci Yuan Hawker Centre has implemented a self-payment kiosk at all stalls, allowing the hawkers to focus on taking orders and cooking.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Similarly, at the hawker centre in OTH, the operator has introduced a cashless payment system for the stalls.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The operators at Bukit Panjang, Ci Yuan and OTH hawker centres have also introduced centralised dishwashing to reduce the hawkers' need for manpower for dishwashing.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Besides improving the hawkers' productivity, centralised dishwashing can also ensure a more hygienic environment for patrons.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Some operators have also offered the purchasing of ingredients in bulk to help hawkers reduce the cost of raw materials.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: We have also seen encouraging initiatives to attract new entrants to the hawker trade.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: For example, the operator at Hougang Ci Yuan Hawker Centre has put in place an entrepreneurship programme.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Placing the management of a group of hawker centres under a single operator will enable the operator to derive economies of scale and have greater flexibility and space to experiment with new ideas and processes to further improve the vibrancy and operational efficiency of the hawker centres for the benefit of both hawkers and patrons.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Hawkers can be assured that there will be no change to the way rents are determined when the operator takes over the management of the existing centres.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Subsidised stallholders will continue to pay subsidised rents while non-subsidised stall-holders will continue to pay the prevailing market rents as assessed by professional valuers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) will work with the operator to explore ways to increase the vibrancy of the centres to enhance the business there and improve the patrons' dining experience.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I also support NEA's approach to try out the new model to finesse the way our hawker centres are run.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Can I ask the Senior Minister of State whether there are good learning points since we implemented the not-for-profit model?

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Has it improved the attractiveness of the hawker professionals and lowered the barrier for entry of aspiring hawkers?

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I understand from stallholders from the Bukit Panjang new market that their new monthly conservancy charges are about almost $2,000.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: They trained these hawkers and provided them the stalls and some initial setting-up costs to operate these stalls.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: These have helped to lower the entry barriers for aspiring hawkers, whether they are young hawkers or people looking to enter the trade.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Between Ci Yuan and OTH, we have new hawkers who were formerly an engineer, accountant, real estate agent.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Recently, at Chinatown Complex Food Centre, I met a former Deputy Superintendent of Police who has become a hawker.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: She has been selling herbal buk kut teh there for more than a month or so.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: All these fees are market-determined and paid directly to the contractors.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: For centralised dishwashing, it is to help the hawkers to address manpower constraints and challenges, as well as to manage manpower costs and improve productivity.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: With centralised dishwashing, what it means is that the hawkers will save on the cost of employing someone to wash the dishes.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: In one of my visits to a hawker centre at Whampoa, which does not have a centralised dishwashing programme at the moment, one of the hawkers has purchased his own dishwashing equipment and that helped him to address his difficulty of getting someone to wash the dishes and saved him nearly the equivalent of one full-time manpower cost.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: That would definitely offset the fees paid for centralised dishwashing.
